narration.text: Kira waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to Millbank with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
A weathered trader waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
🌩️ The sky to the west has gone the color of a bruise. Carlos is already tying things down — rope, tarps, the chicken situation. "Sky like that," Carlos says, "you don't argue with it."
📺 SYSTEM: "We have filed a request for the sky to be less bruised. It is pending. The sky has not responded."
A storm is coming, and it does not care about your plans. Be at Haven by dusk — sheltering costs the dusk foraging window (400–800 kcal you'll never see). Getting caught out costs more.
Village meal: +500 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Carlos came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
🔍 Ella crouches over clover-like leaves, tangy taste, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
Ella traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Larry Daly is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
📖 The entry for Larry is finished. 5 deeds recorded. No more pages.
🕯️ Larry is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

Millbank watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)

narration.text: 💔 Millbank is coming apart from hunger — a faction walked, looking for a fire that feeds. The Hungry Road is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Kira.
📓 Codex: Millbank split (famine-flight). The Hungry Road formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Hank Costa. From Millbank." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
"Millbank is eating bark and calling it dinner," Hank says. "We left before we started looking at each other like food."
They're named, every one: Hank Costa, Ines Cohen. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
📓 Codex: 2 petitioners from Millbank (famine-flight): Hank Costa, Ines Cohen.
Ibrahim waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to Hedge End with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
A sharp-eyed peddler waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
Village meal: +210 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 You make rounds — Carlos gets bound up properly. (30 → 45 HP)
Shannon is showing Caleb how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
Carlos traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Ruby and Jesús lingered over the fire together.
Ruby is getting sharper out there with you — steadier hands, better eyes. (Mentor bonus growing.)
✦ Shannon has found something — Farsight. Days of eagle_eye and pathfinder side by side, and now they move as one. (farsight: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Ruby has found something — Peacemaker's Voice. Days of diplomat and mediator side by side, and now they move as one. (peacemakers_voice: villager synergy discovered)
Your Snare 1 tile east sits empty — nothing it can catch is moving on this ground. Try another tile.
Your Snare 1 tile east sits empty — nothing it can catch is moving on this ground. Try another tile.

🌙 Raid — The Coppice came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~840 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
— DAY 32 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Red Squirrel (cleaned) went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
👀 Ruby claims to belong somewhere — then spends the whole evening oriented around something they won't name. The wanting is real. The word for it isn't "to belong somewhere".
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"I left bandages where the path bends. Don't thank me. Just live."
(378 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
🥣 Wren of Millbank stands at your fire, thinner than pride allows. "Millbank is eating bark. We're asking — 1,525 kcal, whatever you can spare. We'll remember it."
(They beg — give from the beats row, or refuse aloud. If they once fed you, refusing costs double.)

narration.text: 🧳 Millbank has split — the hungry walked. They call the new fire The Hungry Road. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
💔 Hedge End has split over blood — the hardliners walked, and they didn't walk far. The Bloodied is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Alba.
They didn't come to your fire. Hardliners don't ask — Alba is building something out there, and it isn't a farm.
📖 LEARNED: Intimidating Presence (Level 1). You don't have to fight. Most people decide not to, just looking at you.
📺 Strangers paint your face on their walls. In other villages. Villages you've never been to.
◈ TRIAL COMPLETE — the audience applauds, which sounds like static. (+15 integration, gift: a lesson: Intimidating Presence)
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
Village meal: +140 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 You make rounds — Carlos gets bound up properly. (66 → 81 HP)
Shannon came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
Shannon traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Jesús had the day of their life — 1675 kcal. Two days of food from one person.
Jesús and Shannon lingered over the fire together.

— DAY 34 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, European Rabbit (cleaned); Beech mast (in shell); Hazelnut (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
👀 Carlos starts a story with "back when I was a hunting guide..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.
💬 Yara says: "Dreamed again. They showed me teeth. Lots of teeth. Be ready to fight soon."

narration.text: Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Millbank's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.)
Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. The Coppice's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.)
Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Stonebridge's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.)
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Hank nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
Word later: they walked to The Hungry Road. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
Word will travel: Haven is turned away the hungry. Other fires will remember. (Opinion -4 with every village that knows you.)
Someone walks in like they belong here, grinning. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to see it." The System's show has an audience, and audiences talk.
Village meal: +280 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Someone told a joke by the fire. You hear Caleb laugh — a real one.
Ella traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Jesús and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
Jesús is getting sharper out there with you — steadier hands, better eyes. (Mentor bonus growing.)
🤒 Caleb is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.
— DAY 35 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, European Rabbit (cleaned) went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
👀 "hunting guide, huh?" Carlos nods — then, an hour later, drops a shop-talk detail no hunting guide would ever get right. They catch themselves. Too late.
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"Cache by the hollow. Dried meat, clean water. I can't stay. — W."
(205 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
◈ HAVEN — The effortless closeness takes effort now. People notice the effort, and love each other for it.

narration.text: 🌾 Millbank's tribute comes up thin — 112 of 4,000 kcal. They sent everything the wagons could carry, and it wasn't enough. The shortfall rides as arrears (+3,888 kcal). (Trust -1.)
🌾 Tribute from The Coppice arrives — 4,000 kcal of grain into the pantry. Their fields, our fire.
🌾 Nothing comes from Stonebridge this week — their fields are as empty as the wagons look. Hunger isn't defiance, but the ledger doesn't know the difference. (Arrears +4,000 kcal, trust -2.)

🧳 A trader lingers after the meal — your fire eats well, and word travels with full bellies. "East, past the river — three fires walk as ONE now. They've got a speaker for SPEAKERS. Thought you should know there's bigger games than yours."
Jesús, counting on their fingers: "They sent extra this week. I think we're... friends? Is that the word?"
🗣️ Ruby to Yara, by the fire: "222 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
A curious wanderer waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
Village meal: +210 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Carlos traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
📓 Codex: Jesús taught Caleb Diplomatic Incident.
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile west caught a European Rabbit! About 800 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.

🌙 Raid — Millbank came in the night from the northeast. They carried off ~1320 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

🌙 Raid — Stonebridge came in the night from the northeast. They carried off ~1443 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

Fresh-cut stems on the east ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Bloodied's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
— DAY 36 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, European Rabbit (cleaned); Red Squirrel (cleaned) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Hedge End bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.

narration.text: 🧳 A traveler says Hedge End burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the hardliners walked. The Bloodied is the new fire.)

🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
A curious wanderer waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
Carlos is showing Jesús how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
Caleb came back with 690 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Ruby came back with 519 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Yara and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 2 tiles south-west caught a European Rabbit! About 800 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.
Your Snare 2 tiles south-west sits empty — the game trails bend around the hollow now. This ground has learned your trap. Rest it, or move the line.

The northeast ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. Millbank isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
A runner from The Hungry Road, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
The Bloodied's speaker sent a runner: the east ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
A runner from The Bloodied, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the east ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 2). Pressure points: brachial, femoral, carotid. You can stop bleeding or drop someone with a thumb.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Surgical Grace! You heal like a surgeon with infinite tools. Critical heals. (Your knowledge of Anatomy amplifies your field_medicine.)
📖 LEARNED: Solar Disinfection (Level 2). Paint half the bottle black — heats faster, kills more. Shake first to oxygenate.
🌟 JACKPOT: A stranger by the road knows things. They talk for an hour. You learn: Anatomy, Solar Disinfection. Your Codex overflows.
— DAY 38 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food. Ella mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"I left bandages where the path bends. Don't thank me. Just live."
(416 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
💬 Yara says: "Dreamed again. They showed me teeth. Lots of teeth. Be ready to fight soon."
🥣 Wren of Millbank stands at your fire, thinner than pride allows. "Millbank is eating bark. We're asking — 1,726 kcal, whatever you can spare. We'll remember it."
(They beg — give from the beats row, or refuse aloud. If they once fed you, refusing costs double.)

narration.text: 🧳 A traveler from northeast says Stonebridge is starving — Maya's been seen counting empty jars, and the kids have gone quiet.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
It's settled. The village is calling it "Old Gavel." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
🌟 "We have detected elevated attachment to Unit SEED PACKET. This is inefficient. This is also... [PROCESSING] ...valuable? Optimization available." (Choose an enhancement for your Seed packet.)
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
🤒 Caleb is on the mend — the fever broke.
🤒 Shannon is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.

🌙 Raid — Millbank came in the night from the northeast. They carried off ~1449 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

Fresh-cut stems on the northeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (Stonebridge's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
— DAY 39 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Wood sorrel; Blackberry; Red Squirrel (cleaned); Red Squirrel (cleaned) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
👀 Someone asks Carlos a shop-talk question about hunting guide work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.

narration.text: Someone walks in like they belong here, grinning. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to see it." The System's show has an audience, and audiences talk.
It's settled. The village is calling it "Big-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
🌟 "We have detected elevated attachment to Unit OATH RING. This is inefficient. This is also... [PROCESSING] ...valuable? Optimization available." (Choose an enhancement for your Oath Ring.)
Village meal: +478 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

Yara spends the afternoon with the leafy plant among the undergrowth — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. Edible, but it argues on the way down. The fire's verdict: food, carefully. Small amounts.
From the lumped bag: Red clover — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Red clover. A name is a beginning, not permission to eat. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 You see it again in your mind: a leafy plant among the undergrowth. Yara's words land on the memory like a label. Red clover. Of course.
SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.
The Codex notes it: Red clover — edible, carefully. (Yara tested it.)
Ella came back with 507 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Jesús and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
Yara is getting sharper out there with you — steadier hands, better eyes. (Mentor bonus growing.)
✦ Yara has found something — Farsight. Days of eagle_eye and pathfinder side by side, and now they move as one. (farsight: villager synergy discovered)
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile west caught a European Rabbit! About 800 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.
The Snare broke. You'll need another.
— DAY 41 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food. Yara mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"The System flagged your sector. Move. NOW."
(326 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)

narration.text: The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
A curious wanderer waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
★ IDENTIFIED: Jerusalem Artichoke. Tall sunflower stalks; dig at the base for knobby tubers. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
📚 Village knowledge: Ella taught everyone about Jerusalem Artichoke. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
🌟 "We have detected elevated attachment to Unit KNIFE ROLL. This is inefficient. This is also... [PROCESSING] ...valuable? Optimization available." (Choose an enhancement for your Knife roll.)
Village meal: +300 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Someone told a joke by the fire. You hear Yara laugh — a real one.
Fireside lesson: Ella passes around Jerusalem Artichoke. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
Caleb traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Jesús and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
Yara and Ruby lingered over the fire together.
Ruby is getting sharper out there with you — steadier hands, better eyes. (Mentor bonus growing.)
Shannon shows you Beard Moss — not the power, just the shape of it. Watch and learn.
📓 Codex: you've SEEN **Beard Moss** now. Moss grows in your beard/hair. You always have tinder. (Looks great, honestly.)

💬 Yara says: "The voice said 'north.' Just... north. I don't know what it means."

narration.text: Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile south caught a European Rabbit! About 800 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.

🌙 Raid — The Coppice came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~1000 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

🌙 Raid — Stonebridge came in the night from the northeast. They carried off ~1400 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
— DAY 43 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Beech mast (in shell); Hazelnut (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food. Caleb mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)

narration.text: Yara again, quieter: "Three weeks we've known them. Feels longer."
🥣 Ibrahim of Hedge End walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
🗣️ Ella to Carlos, by the fire: "219 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
A weathered trader waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
🤒 Shannon is on the mend — the fever broke.
— DAY 44 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, European Rabbit (cleaned) went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food, Foraged food (dried). Caleb mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
👀 Ruby claims to belong somewhere — then spends the whole evening oriented around something they won't name. The wanting is real. The word for it isn't "to belong somewhere".
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"I left bandages where the path bends. Don't thank me. Just live."
(424 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
👁 "Don't — don't react. I'm Wren. I'm not supposed to talk to you. Just... there's a cache by the old hollow. No one saw me. Go."
◈ You understand now: that wasn't human. That was Wren — Student, Vexari Exchange Program — wearing a person like a suit. (you spotted her leaving a cache)

narration.text: Someone walks in like they belong here, grinning. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to see it." The System's show has an audience, and audiences talk.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
— DAY 45 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Red clover went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food, Foraged food (dried). Caleb mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
◈ You understand now: that wasn't human. That was Rax "The Dentist" — Pain Enthusiast, Unlicensed — wearing a person like a suit. (the System feed named them)
💬 Bill says: "Someone's been leaving food out. Good food. Don't ask me how I know it wasn't one of us."

narration.text: Ibrahim waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to Hedge End with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
A curious wanderer waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
It's settled. The village is calling it "The Loud Beast." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
⚠ DEHYDRATED: find and treat water today.
Village meal: +209 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Ruby is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 72/100)
Caleb: "Stinging Nettle is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Yara and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
Caleb and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
— DAY 46 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, unknown shoots; European Rabbit (cleaned); Beech mast (in shell); Hazelnut (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food, Snared meat. Ruby mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
💬 Yara says: "Dreamed again. They showed me teeth. Lots of teeth. Be ready to fight soon."
📦 A package arrives, wrapped in black ribbon. The card reads: "With love, Rax "The Dentist"."
Inside: a beautiful alien medkit. It's... ticking? No — it's humming. It's humming your name.
(It's a tracker. Rax "The Dentist" now knows where you sleep. The medkit is real, though — out here you don't throw those away.)

narration.text: ◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."
Three weeks of knowing Millbank — and now it's real. Haven is regional.
◈ SYSTEM: "Oh! The chat is doing the thing again — they're RANKING fires. Yours is... climbing. They keep asking which fire climbs FIRST. No pressure. (SO much pressure.)"

🔍 Jesús crouches over a fruiting plant along the woodland edge, studying it a moment before moving on. (2/3 looks)
Jesús traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Shannon came back with 352 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile west caught a European Rabbit! About 800 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.

🌙 Raid — The Coppice came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~925 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

narration.text: Word from The Coppice: Sanne holds the fire now. It resolved without you.
A stranger at the tree line, watching. Not hiding, exactly. Measuring. They'll be gone by dusk — but they'll remember what they saw.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
Village meal: +475 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Quiet mending sounds from the bunks — Carlos fixing something.
Carlos: "Hazelnut is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🤒 Jesús is on the mend — the fever broke.
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile west caught a European Rabbit! About 800 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.
The Snare broke. You'll need another.
Your Snare 1 tile east sits empty — nothing it can catch is moving on this ground. Try another tile.
— DAY 54 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food, Buried cache. Ella mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"The System flagged your sector. Move. NOW."
(270 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
💬 Yara says: "They said you're doing well. It sounded... proud? Can they feel proud?"

narration.text: 🗣️ Caleb to Jesús, by the fire: "227 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
A lean scout waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
Village meal: +352 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🔍 Ella has been turning over clover-like leaves, tangy taste for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
Ella had the day of their life — 1650 kcal. Two days of food from one person.
Jesús and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
Jesús is getting sharper out there with you — steadier hands, better eyes. (Mentor bonus growing.)
🤒 Ella is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.
— DAY 55 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Red clover went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food. Ruby mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
💬 Jesús says: "Someone's been leaving food out. Good food. Don't ask me how I know it wasn't one of us."

narration.text: 🌾 Tribute from Stonebridge arrives — 4,000 kcal of grain into the pantry. Their fields, our fire.
🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (mosquito, The Paparazzo, Extended Warranty) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 mosquito, The Paparazzo, Extended Warranty is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
The defenders met them at the treeline — nothing reached your bedroll.
★ IDENTIFIED: Crab apple. A name is a beginning, not permission to eat. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.
📚 Village knowledge: Jesús taught everyone about Crab apple. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Village meal: +400 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 You make rounds — Yara gets bound up properly. (40 → 55 HP)
Shannon and Carlos are comparing scars like trading cards.
Fireside lesson: Jesús passes around Crab apple. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
🔍 Yara has been turning over low shrubs, small dark-purple berries, mountain slopes and clearings for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
Yara traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Your Snare 1 tile east sits empty — nothing it can catch is moving on this ground. Try another tile.
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
— DAY 57 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Wood sorrel; Blackberry; Red Squirrel (cleaned) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food. Yara mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"They're sending Vex after you tomorrow. He's bored. Be somewhere else."
(451 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
💬 Bill says: "That Rax "The Dentist"... I don't like the way it looks at you. Be careful."
📦 A plain package, no card. Inside: real food, clean bandages, and a note in handwriting you almost recognize:
"Eat. Rest. They're watching the skies, not the ground. — a friend"

★ IDENTIFIED: Huckleberry. Small dark berries, mountain slopes. Bears love them. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
📚 Village knowledge: Yara taught everyone about Huckleberry. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
Village meal: +400 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 You make rounds — Jesús gets bound up properly. (62 → 77 HP)
Jesús came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)

Ella has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Yara is showing everyone Huckleberry by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
Ella came back with 656 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Carlos is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 83/100)
Jesús and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
Yara and Ruby lingered over the fire together.
📖 LEARNED: Ant Trail (Level 2). Deeper understanding of ant trail.
📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 2). Edges, disturbed ground, last year’s growth — you read a hillside like a menu and strip it clean.
📖 LEARNED: Improvised Weapons (Level 2). You see weapons in the environment: choke points, heavy objects, things that burn.
🌟 JACKPOT: A stranger by the road knows things. They talk for an hour. You learn: Ant Trail, The Forager’s Eye, Improvised Weapons. Your Codex overflows.
— DAY 58 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

📖 LEARNED: Swimmer (Level 1). Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.

narration.text: 🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Coppice has bound itself to Stonebridge. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
Zoe waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Hungry Road with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
They come fast and scared — a family, or what's left of one. "Please. We heard you take people in." Behind them, something worse than weather.

narration.text: 🌙 Night. The lingering Extended Warranty gorges at the treeline — 1,000 kcal gone from the stores. Drive it off, or call for help.
🌙 Night. The lingering The Paparazzo gorges at the treeline — 1,000 kcal gone from the stores. Drive it off, or call for help.
They come fast and scared — a family, or what's left of one. "Please. We heard you take people in." Behind them, something worse than weather.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
Village meal: +400 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 You make rounds — Shannon gets bound up properly. (63 → 78 HP)
Carlos is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 79/100)
Ruby and Jesús lingered over the fire together.
🌿 Hawthorn haw, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
🌿 Stinging Nettle, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Stinging Nettle: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
🌿 Pokeweed, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Pokeweed: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
🌿 Sloe, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.

🌙 Raid — The Coppice came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~600 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
— DAY 74 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Wood sorrel went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
📦 A package arrives, wrapped in black ribbon. The card reads: "With love, Rax "The Dentist"."
Inside: a beautiful alien medkit. It's... ticking? No — it's humming. It's humming your name.
(It's a tracker. Rax "The Dentist" now knows where you sleep. The medkit is real, though — out here you don't throw those away.)

narration.text: ◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."

👑 Speakers from Millbank, The Coppice, Stonebridge ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
📓 Codex: National beat staged: lead (4 villages).
🥣 Ibrahim of Hedge End walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
★ IDENTIFIED: American Ginseng. Ginseng. Whorled compound leaves, red berry cluster. You've only read about this. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
📚 Village knowledge: Yara taught everyone about American Ginseng. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Village meal: +433 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Jesús is humming something. It stops when they notice you listening.
Fireside lesson: Yara passes around American Ginseng. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
Shannon came back with 458 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Yara and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
Caleb and Jesús lingered over the fire together.
🤒 Ella is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.
🛟 Jesús stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch the fever in the tents happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Triage tents and broth for the sick, or half rations till it passes, or the healthy hunt hard to keep everyone fed. Pick — everything costs."
"Or we rally," Jesús adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
— DAY 77 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Wood sorrel went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.

The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food, Foraged food (dried). Carlos mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
💬 Yara says: "That Rax "The Dentist"... I don't like the way it looks at you. Be careful."
🏃 Felix of Millbank walks into Haven unannounced, pack-mules behind. "Heard your bins are echoing. Millbank has grain to spare — 1,855 kcal, no tribute, no ceremony. Say the word."
(Aid offer — accept or refuse from the beats row. Refusing costs pride: trust -3.)

narration.text: 🌾 Tribute from The Coppice arrives — 5,000 kcal of grain into the pantry. Their fields, our fire.
🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Bloodied has bound itself to Stonebridge. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.

◈ SYSTEM: "37. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."

📡 The feed floods in — fan art, messages in languages nobody speaks, a countdown that isn't yours. The audience demands Haven for the world feed: SEND your speaker into the light, FEAST the cameras with a grand showing, or DECLINE and let the galaxy watch you say no.
📓 Codex: The Watchers: the world feed wants Haven.
🧳 Word from The Coppice: traders say The Coppice had a new speaker — or so the traders say
📓 Codex: Word from The Coppice: traders say The Coppice had a new speaker — or so the traders say
◈ SYSTEM: "Oh. OH. Do you feel that? That's the whole PLANET leaning in. ...There's a table, little fires. A big one. Far away. And it is LOOKING at you. Give it a season worth judging."
🗣️ Shannon to Carlos, by the fire: "226 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
Ants march past your boot, laden. You follow them to a seep. +1L water (risky). (ant_trail)
Village meal: +260 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Someone told a joke by the fire. You hear Ella laugh — a real one.
Shannon came back with 357 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Ruby and Jesús lingered over the fire together.
🌿 Purslane, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Purslane: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
— DAY 78 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Blackberry, Foraged food. Jesús mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"Cache by the hollow. Dried meat, clean water. I can't stay. — W."
(383 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)

📓 Codex: Kira of The Hungry Road raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.

⬢ SYSTEM: "Shannon has built the body. The crown is ours to give."

✨ CAPSTONE: Seed Vault. Every seed you have ever pocketed, kept dry and dreaming. It weighs almost nothing. Almost. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
📓 Codex: The System granted Shannon the Seed Vault — a finished The Living Garden build recognized.
Everything stops. Not all at once — conversations trail off, a dropped spoon rings too loud. Every face turns toward Shannon.

Carlos: "I saw it happen. I was THERE."
Caleb: "We all felt it. Like the air changed its mind."
Jesús: "I have no words. I am making do with these."

The soil near you is warm. Things are growing that you didn't plant. Look at Shannon. Look at what the light does around them now. Shannon is The Living Garden — Blooming, Grown-Over. A figure half-lost in vines and blossoms — green-gold, flowers opening along the shoulders, roots at the feet. The garden, walking.

Godhood demands its price, and the price is not hidden: Once per day. It costs you 200 kcal of your own — the garden gives, but through you. You're not a fighter. Your garden needs guards, and everyone knows it.

narration.text: Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
★ IDENTIFIED: Prickly Pear. Flat pads, sharp spines. The fruits are called tunas. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.
Ella was watching. Now they know Prickly Pear too.
📚 Village knowledge: Jesús taught everyone about Prickly Pear. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
Village meal: +280 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 You make rounds — Shannon gets bound up properly. (39 → 54 HP)
Caleb and Ruby are arguing about the watch rotation. Again. It's almost comforting.
Fireside lesson: Jesús passes around Prickly Pear. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
Yara is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 73/100)
Ruby is getting sharper out there with you — steadier hands, better eyes. (Mentor bonus growing.)
🤒 Ella is on the mend — the fever broke.
— DAY 82 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Hawthorn haw; Beech mast (in shell); Hazelnut (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Sloe, Foraged food. Ruby mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
On the carcass nearby, Old Gavel (carcass) went bad — maggots, smell, the whole sad story. Leaving it had a cost.

A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.

🩹 You make rounds — Shannon gets bound up properly. (57 → 72 HP)
Ruby is showing everyone European elderberry by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
💡 European elderberry: the village and a trader know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
Yara came back with 465 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
🔍 Ella crouches over broad smooth green leaves in spring colonies, strong onion smell when crushed, studying it a moment before moving on. (2/3 looks)
Ella traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Jesús and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
📓 Codex: Jesús taught Shannon Generous Heart.
🤒 Shannon is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.

💬 Bill says: "Someone's been leaving food out. Good food. Don't ask me how I know it wasn't one of us."
💬 Yara says: "They said you're doing well. It sounded... proud? Can they feel proud?"

narration.text: 🧳 Word from Stonebridge: Cole is dead, and Mei and Ibrahim both claim the fire. Stonebridge is choosing — or fighting.
🏃 A runner from Stonebridge comes in muddy and breathless. "Cole is dead, and the fire's got two mouths arguing over it. Stonebridge is asking Haven to back a claimant."
📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
◈ TRIAL COMPLETE — the audience applauds, which sounds like static. (+15 integration, gift: a lesson: Patient Aim)
🗣️ Ella to Carlos, by the fire: "239 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
Village meal: +376 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Ella came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)

narration.text: 🌾 Tribute from Stonebridge arrives — 5,000 kcal of grain into the pantry. Their fields, our fire.
🧳 Word from Millbank: traders say Millbank had a good harvest — or so the traders say
📡 The world feed: The Coppice — a feud settled. The chat has opinions.
🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Ugly-Eyes, Performance Review, Big-Eyes, Extended Warranty) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 Ugly-Eyes, Performance Review, Big-Eyes, Extended Warranty is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
(The new things wearing your shapes are already here. The horror: it's made of you.)
🔥 Ella, at the fire: "Of course it looks like us. Flattering. Still killing it."
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Performance Review is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
The defenders met them at the treeline — nothing reached your bedroll.
A curious wanderer waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
Village meal: +300 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 You make rounds — Jesús gets bound up properly. (2 → 17 HP)
Shannon is humming something. It stops when they notice you listening.
Caleb is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 85/100)
Jesús and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
Ruby is getting sharper out there with you — steadier hands, better eyes. (Mentor bonus growing.)
✦ Shannon has found something — Peacemaker's Voice. Days of diplomat and mediator side by side, and now they move as one. (peacemakers_voice: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Ella has found something — Polyglot's Ledger. Days of translator and open_book side by side, and now they move as one. (polyglots_ledger: villager synergy discovered)
📓 Codex: Jesús taught Shannon Silver Tongue.
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
— DAY 92 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Wood sorrel went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food. Carlos mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
📦 A care package drops from the sky with a little parachute. There's a note: "WE LOVE YOU! — your showbiz fans"
Inside: Ghost Camo
Plus 31 kcal of fan-approved snacks.

narration.text: 🌙 Night. The lingering Extended Warranty gorges at the treeline — 1,240 kcal gone from the stores. Drive it off, or call for help.
🌙 Night. The lingering Ugly-Eyes gorges at the treeline — 1,000 kcal gone from the stores. Drive it off, or call for help.
🌙 Night. The lingering Big-Eyes gorges at the treeline — 1,400 kcal gone from the stores. Drive it off, or call for help.
A stranger at the tree line, watching. Not hiding, exactly. Measuring. They'll be gone by dusk — but they'll remember what they saw.
Ants march past your boot, laden. You follow them to a seep. +1L water (risky). (ant_trail)
Village meal: +400 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 You make rounds — Jesús gets bound up properly. (20 → 35 HP)
Jesús is showing Ruby how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
🔍 Yara has been turning over low heart-shaped leaves hugging the forest floor, hiding small jug-shaped flowers at the base for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
Yara came back with 297 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Ruby is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 41/100)
🤒 Jesús is feverish, a cut gone hot and angry. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.

🛟 Carlos stands up by the fire. "People are going down and the tents are filling — we do something or we don't, but we decide. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"We can nurse them through it, or go lean and ride it out, or send the strong out hunting while the sick rest. Say which."
"Or we rally," Carlos adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile west caught a Brown Hare! About 1200 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.
— DAY 93 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Hawthorn haw went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food. Carlos mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"I left bandages where the path bends. Don't thank me. Just live."
(384 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
💬 Yara says: "They said you're doing well. It sounded... proud? Can they feel proud?"
🏃 Felix of Millbank walks into Haven unannounced, pack-mules behind. "Heard your bins are echoing. Millbank has grain to spare — 2,717 kcal, no tribute, no ceremony. Say the word."
(Aid offer — accept or refuse from the beats row. Refusing costs pride: trust -3.)

narration.text: Ibrahim waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to Hedge End with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
The village debates a tired mechanic. The room is cold — Jesús, Caleb, Ella against. "More mouths, same fire." (33% for.)
🌙 Night. The lingering Extended Warranty gorges at the treeline — 800 kcal gone from the stores. Drive it off, or call for help.
🌙 Night. The lingering Big-Eyes gorges at the treeline — 1,135 kcal gone from the stores. Drive it off, or call for help.
Someone walks in like they belong here, grinning. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to see it." The System's show has an audience, and audiences talk.
👁️ A curious wanderer cornered Caleb. "Nice village. Be a shame if something happened to it."
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
Village meal: +400 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 You make rounds — Jesús gets bound up properly. (36 → 51 HP)
Ella traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
📓 Codex: Shannon taught Caleb Silver Tongue.
🤒 Caleb is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.
🛟 Shannon stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch the fever in the tents happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"We can nurse them through it, or go lean and ride it out, or send the strong out hunting while the sick rest. Say which."
"Or we rally," Shannon adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
— DAY 96 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Sloe went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"I left bandages where the path bends. Don't thank me. Just live."
(358 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Bloodied bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Beloved. Strangers ask for your blessing. You don't know what to do with that.
📊 THE STANDINGS — Haven sits 1st of 7. Haven leads. The audience has a favorite, and it's you.

narration.text: 📨 Word came: Ines Duarte wants to join Haven. "I saw you on the broadcast. You looked like people who eat." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
The village debates Ines Duarte. Warm, mostly. "One more pair of hands." (83% for.)
📨 The village didn't wait for you. Ines Duarte was vouched for around the fire — they're walking.
Accepted. Ines Duarte is walking. They'll reach Haven in a few days — membership starts when they arrive, but the village already counts them.
🌙 Night. The lingering Extended Warranty gorges at the treeline — 1,400 kcal gone from the stores. Drive it off, or call for help.
🌙 Night. The lingering Big-Eyes gorges at the treeline — 1,600 kcal gone from the stores. Drive it off, or call for help.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
★ IDENTIFIED: Wild Onion. Grass-like, smells like onion. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
📚 Village knowledge: Ella taught everyone about Wild Onion. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Village meal: +200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Caleb is staring into the fire like it owes them answers.
Fireside lesson: Ella passes around Wild Onion. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
🔍 Ella crouches over a vine with elaborate purple-and-white flowers and egg-sized green fruit that wrinkles yellow when ripe, studying it a moment before moving on. (2/3 looks)
Ella: "Elderberry is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Jesús and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
🤒 Jesús is on the mend — the fever broke.
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile west caught a European Rabbit! About 800 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.
— DAY 98 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Wood sorrel went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.

The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food, Snared meat, Foraged food (dried). Shannon mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)

narration.text: 🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Kira of The Hungry Road didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 5,000 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
📨 Word came: Ethan Hunt wants to join Haven. "Word travels: Haven takes people in. I'm people." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
🚶 Ines Duarte walks in — pack light, eyes wide. Haven grows by one. (9 souls.)
🗣️ Caleb to Ines, by the fire: "260 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
★ IDENTIFIED: Serviceberry. White spring flowers, clusters of red-purple berries in June. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
📚 Village knowledge: Ella taught everyone about Serviceberry. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
Ella is showing everyone Serviceberry by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
Ines had the day of their life — 1461 kcal. Two days of food from one person.
Jesús and Shannon lingered over the fire together.
Yara is getting sharper out there with you — steadier hands, better eyes. (Mentor bonus growing.)

🌿 Foxglove, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Foxglove: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
🤒 Nadia is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.
Your Snare 2 tiles west sits empty — the game trails bend around the hollow now. This ground has learned your trap. Rest it, or move the line.
The Coppice's speaker sent a runner: the southeast ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.

🌙 Raid — Hedge End came in the night from the northeast. They carried off ~891 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

Fresh-cut stems on the northeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Hungry Road's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
— DAY 101 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Wood sorrel; Brown Hare (cleaned) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food. Shannon mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"I left bandages where the path bends. Don't thank me. Just live."
(327 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)

narration.text: The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn hotter from here.)
That night, they bring Bill home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
★ IDENTIFIED: Groundnut. Twining vine in wet ground; dig for strings of round tubers. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
📚 Village knowledge: Ethan taught everyone about Groundnut. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
Ants march past your boot, laden. You follow them to a seep. +1L water (risky). (ant_trail)
